title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Tourism - Rating
description: A rating of a tourism resource, service or organisation (estur:Rating, SEGITTUR Core Tourism Ontology). NOTE: the source ontology's own SHACL shapes define a different, incompatible field set for Rating (bookingValue/googleReviewValue/tripAdvisorValue as floats, plus a flat 'stars' integer directly on Hotel) that does not match either the OWL property definitions or any real example data found. This candidate follows ratingUnit/ratingValue because that is what the real, published open-data examples (and the OWL definitions) actually use — check with SEGITTUR before assuming either naming scheme is final.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Rating'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

ratingUnit.description: Property. Unit associated to the rating of a resource, service or organisation, e.g. 'stars' for a hotel star rating (estur:ratingUnit).

ratingValue.description: Property. Value associated to the rating, e.g. '3' for a 3-star rating (estur:ratingValue).
